- Search Engine Optimisation (SEO): Technical crawl architecture, Core Web Vitals remediation, semantic keyword clusters, and sustainable domain authority.

- Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO): Long-form topical authority, corporate knowledge graph alignment, and conversational citation engineering.
- Website Design and Development: Sub-second, mobile-first static web architecture built on Astro, Tailwind CSS, clean semantic markup, and zero layout shift.
